original_record.question: Brick Cord Pull Fig. 2 A brick at rest on a horizontal table is pulled by a horizontal cord, as shown in Fig. 2. The force of friction on the brick

options.A: Increase if the pull increases but the brick does not move.
options.B: Is directly horizontal to the right
options.C: Decreases if an identical brick is placed on the first.
options.D: Is zero if the brick is pulled hard enough to make it slide.
options.E: Change if the brick is turned on its side.

original_record.ai_explanation: Static friction is not zero when the brick slides; kinetic friction acts on the moving brick, so the statement that friction is zero when pulled hard enough to slide is incorrect.
